tools.name: hex_list_games
tools.description: List all available hex map game types with configuration options

tools.name: hex_generate_map
tools.description: Generate a hex map for a specific game and player count

tools.name: hex_export_svg
tools.description: Generate a hex map and export as SVG

tools.name: hex_get_info
tools.description: Get info about a specific hex coordinate (terrain, neighbours, distance)

tools.name: hex_compute_fov
tools.description: Compute field of view from a hex position

tools.name: hex_pathfind
tools.description: Find shortest path between two hex coordinates

tools.name: play_list_families
tools.description: List all playable game families supported by the engine (chess, draughts, go, reversi, shogi, xiangqi, mancala, morris, hex, landlords-game, backgammon, standard-52, bavarian-32, flower-48, double-six-dominoes, mahjong, standard-dice, agon, asalto, chaupar, dou-shou-qi, fanorona, halma, nyout, pachi

tools.name: play_list_variants
tools.description: List available variants for a game family. Each variant can be passed to play_create_game. Variants with flags (e.g. +random) can be requested as "slug+flag".

tools.name: play_get_definition
tools.description: Get the full engine definition (topology, render config, pieces, setup FEN) for a game variant. Returns the resolved frontmatter used to render and play the game.

tools.name: play_create_game
tools.description: Create a new game instance for a given family. Returns initial state to pass to subsequent calls. Variant can include flags like "grand+random" or "standard+drops".

tools.name: play_get_moves
tools.description: Get all legal moves for the current position. Requires state from play_create_game or play_apply_move.

tools.name: play_apply_move
tools.description: Apply a move to the game and return the new state. Pass the move object exactly as returned by play_get_moves (format varies by family: chess uses {from,to}, go uses {coord} or {action:"pass"}).

tools.name: play_check_status
tools.description: Check the current game status: whose turn it is, whether the game is over, and who won.

tools.name: play_suggest_move
tools.description: Use AI to analyse the position and suggest the best move. Supports 5 difficulty levels across all 30 playable families.

tools.name: play_render_board
tools.description: Render the current board position as SVG for any playable family (chess, draughts, go, reversi, shogi, xiangqi, mancala, morris, hex, landlords-game, backgammon, standard-52, bavarian-32, flower-48, double-six-dominoes, mahjong, standard-dice, agon, asalto, chaupar, dou-shou-qi, fanorona, halma, nyo

tools.name: play_export_fen
tools.description: Export the current board position as a FEN-style setup string, in the form the variant's own frontmatter declares its starting position. Card, tile and dice games have no board position to export.

tools.name: play_load_fen
tools.description: Create a game from a FEN-style setup string, as returned by play_export_fen. Pass the same variant the position was exported from.

tools.name: play_validate_move
tools.description: Check whether a move is legal in the current position without applying it. Pass the move object in the same format as play_get_moves returns.

tools.name: play_make_moves
tools.description: Apply a sequence of moves to a game and return the final state. Stops at the first illegal move. Move objects must match play_get_moves format.

tools.name: rules_list_games
tools.description: List all available game rulebooks with metadata (players, duration, complexity, mechanics). Filterable by type, complexity, and mechanics.

tools.name: rules_get_game
tools.description: Get full rulebook content for a specific game (markdown). For metadata only, use rules_get_game_meta instead.

tools.name: rules_get_game_meta
tools.description: Get structured metadata for a game: players, duration, complexity, mechanics, how_to_play, variant list, page list, related games. Lightweight alternative to fetching the full rulebook.

tools.name: rules_get_page
tools.description: Get a specific page/section from a game rulebook (e.g. character creation, combat rules, marketplace). Use rules_get_game_meta to see available pages.

tools.name: rules_get_variant_list
tools.description: List all variants for a game with structured metadata (players, board, playable status, topology, engine config). Much richer than parsing the rulebook.

tools.name: rules_get_diagram
tools.description: Get board diagram SVG URL for a game variant. Returns the diagram path, topology, and rendering metadata.

tools.name: rules_get_variant
tools.description: Get rules for a specific game variant

tools.name: rules_search
tools.description: Full-text search across all published rulebooks. Returns section-typed results with deep-link anchors.

tools.name: rules_random
tools.description: Get a random game suggestion from the library
